notes.tech: Thread proposed 4 (2026-10-11): Apparel: On DryTec (moisture management), On ThermaTec (insulation), On GuardTec (weather protection), Illuson (reflective); footwear: CloudTec cushioning, Helion superfoam, Speedboard, Missiongrip, LightSpray (sprayed one-piece upper), CleanCloud, Cyclon (trademarks listed in the 20-F) — owned trademarks: CloudTec, Speedboard, Helion, Missiongrip, Cyclon, LightSpray, CleanCloud (On Holding 20-F FY2025 trademark list); On DryTec/ThermaTec/GuardTec are house fabric-technology names (mill not named); no licensed membrane or fill brand named on the men's apparel pages read; share of range men's apparel: 40 of 114 styles (35%) carry a technology tag in the store feed (. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
notes.craft: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-11): On makes almost nothing itself: its own 20-F says substantially all products come from third-party suppliers, with one new Zurich facility for certain LightSpray shoes. Apparel pages name no maker or mill but state the country of origin on every style read (Vietnam or Turkey). Engineering and technology are documented; making is not. That is a 2: a country, honestly stated, and little else. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

craft_evidence.owned: partial, footwear only: the 20-F for FY2025 says On "do[es] not own or operate any significant manufacturing facilities" but opened a production facility in Zurich in 2025 to make certain LightSpray products; substantially all products are made by third parties (fewer than 30 suppliers; apparel and accessories from 16 suppliers in Vietnam, Turkey, China and Indonesia)
craft_evidence.makers: no (no factory or maker named on any of the 114 men's apparel pages read)
craft_evidence.mills: no (no cloth or yarn mill named; fabric technologies carry On's own names only)
craft_evidence.madein: 100% (114 of 114 men's apparel PDPs carry a "Country of origin" line: Vietnam 93, Turkey 21)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated, loosely placed: about page says it "started in the Swiss Alps" with Olivier Bernhard's garden-hose prototype, Caspar Coppetti and David Allemann joining in 2010; company seat Zurich (20-F)
craft_evidence.process: partial: LightSpray (robot-sprayed one-piece upper, Zurich facility) and CloudTec are described; no making process for apparel beyond fabric-technology claims
craft_evidence.reasoning: On makes almost nothing itself: its own 20-F says substantially all products come from third-party suppliers, with one new Zurich facility for certain LightSpray shoes. Apparel pages name no maker or mill but state the country of origin on every style read (Vietnam or Turkey). Engineering and technology are documented; making is not. That is a 2: a country, honestly stated, and little else.

ownership.owner: On Holding AG (NYSE: ONON), listed; Class B voting-rights shares held by the extended founder team concentrate voting control (20-F FY2025: 296,873,353 Class A and 341,241,680 Class B shares at 31 Dec 2025); co-founders Allemann and Coppetti are executive co-chairmen, Bernhard executive director, Martin Hoffmann CEO and CFO
